questions.q: Milk and water are mixed in the ratio 7 : 3. How much water must be added to 10 litres of the mixture to make the ratio 7 : 5?
questions.why: 10 L has 7 L milk and 3 L water. For 7 : 5 water must be 5 L: add 2 L. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2026.

questions.q: Deepak invests ₹1,20,000 at 12% simple interest. Kiran invests ₹1,00,000 at 10% compounded annually. Find the difference between their interest after 3 years.
questions.why: SI = 43,200. CI = 1,00,000 × (1.331 − 1) = 33,100. Difference 10,100. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: How many seconds will a 500 m long train take to cross a man walking at 3 km/h in the same direction, if the train's speed is 63 km/h?
questions.why: Relative speed 60 km/h = 50/3 m/s; 500 ÷ 50/3 = 30 s. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: Statement: "Investing in renewable energy can reduce our carbon footprint." Argument A: Renewables are expensive to implement. Argument B: Renewables are key to reducing long-term environmental damage. Which is stronger?
questions.why: B speaks directly to the statement's goal; cost alone does not answer it. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. C is at the extreme left. A is third from the right end. B is to the immediate right of A. D sits next to both C and E. Who is at the extreme right?
questions.why: C is first, A fourth and B fifth. D must be second with E third, which leaves the sixth seat for F.

questions.q: The average age of 30 students is 15 years. Including the teacher, the average rises by 1. What is the teacher's age?
The present ages of Neha and Deepak are in the ratio 4 : 2. After 6 years the ratio will be 19 : 11. What is Deepak's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 4k and 2k: (4k + 6)/(2k + 6) = 19/11 gives k = 8, so Deepak is 16. GPSC-style practice item.
